---
title: "Credits and attribution"
---

This Quarto Design Kit draws substantial visual inspiration from Quartz and
adapts selected styling ideas to Quarto; the precise sources and modification
record are in the third-party source list.

Quartz supplied design reference rather than a runtime dependency. Schibsted
Grotesk, Source Sans 3, and IBM Plex Mono are bundled locally under their SIL
Open Font Licenses. Source Sans 3 is the intentional version-pinned Source
Sans Pro successor adaptation for body text; Schibsted Grotesk owns titles and
navigation UI. Lucide icons are bundled locally under its ISC license and Feather-derived MIT
notices. The Kit's own source is MIT licensed; that does not replace any of
these third-party terms.

- [Third-party source list](THIRD_PARTY.md)
- [Bundled asset manifest](ASSET_MANIFEST.md)
- [Kit MIT license](LICENSE)
